text.text: The Cisco Nexus 2332TQ Fabric Extender supports 32 100M/1G/10GbaseT host port interfaces and 4 40 Gigabit Ethernet fabric interfaces in a compact, power-efficient form factor. Together with Cisco Nexus parent switches, you can deploy a flexible and scalable server access solution for the data center ideally suited for for customers with low density,low power requirements while still using the same cabling system.
